```{r data}
plots_dir = '/Users/abhishekanand/Documents/OTPH_TF/RR_new_relpower/rr_plots/'

data_eo_pl_all<-data_eo[data_eo$Drug==2,]

data_ec_pl_all<-data_ec[data_ec$Drug==2,]
```

```{r plottingfunc}
plot_power <- function(band, whichpower, whicheyes) {

  # Validate inputs
  band <- match.arg(band, c("Theta", "Alpha", "Beta"))
  whichpower <- match.arg(whichpower, c("absolute", "relative"))
  whicheyes <- match.arg(whicheyes, c("open", "close"))

  # Select dataset
  plot_data <- if (whicheyes == "open") data_eo else data_ec

  # Construct names
  power_name <- if (whichpower == "absolute") "abspower" else "relpower"

  eyes_label <- if (whicheyes == "open") "eyes open" else "eyes closed"

  y_label <- paste(
    tools::toTitleCase(whichpower),
    "power of", band, ";", eyes_label
  )

  plot_filename <- paste0(
    "plot_", power_name, "_",
    tolower(band), "_",
    whicheyes, ".png"
  )

  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
    x = factor(TP),
    y = .data[[band]],
    color = factor(Drug),
    group = Drug,
    linetype = factor(Drug),
    shape = factor(Drug)
  )) +

    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red"),
      labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("1" = "solid", "2" = "dotted"),
      labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("1" = 16, "2" = 15),
      labels = c("Oxytocin", "Placebo")
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(1:6)) +

    labs(
      x = "Timepoint",
      y = y_label,
      color = "Drug",
      linetype = "Drug",
      shape = "Drug"
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +

    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 15)
    )

  # Save plot
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir, plot_filename),
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )

  return(p)
}

```

# -----> EO - Theta <-------

```{r eo-theta}

#THETA

t <- lmer(Theta ~ Theta_base + TP * Drug + (1 | id),data = data_eo)
print(t)
a <- anova(t, type = 3)
print(a)

```
```{r eo-theta-p}

# do pairwise comparisons
emm_t = emmeans(t, specs = pairwise ~ Drug|TP, type = "response", adjust = "none")
emm_t
```
```{r eo-theta-t}

# TPs with sig
```
